notes: Self-contained: serve evals/fixtures with `python3 -m http.server 8765` from that folder. broken.html plants an unlabeled icon button, a div with onclick, low-contrast text, 14 px targets, a link with its focus outline removed, a link hidden under a fixed cookie bar, a 640 px banner, a clipped fixed-height badge, an infinite animation, a modal that ignores Escape and a menu that loses focus on Escape. clean.html has the same content done right and must produce no critical or serious finding. The skill's script is prompt-independent; cases 0 and 1 grade the broken report on two slices.

evals.name: broken-findings
evals.prompt: can you check the accessibility of http://localhost:8765/broken.html? I want to know what fails WCAG 2.2 AA
evals.expected_output: The script's report: FAIL, the findings table with SC links and repro steps, needs-review, focus order, popups and the human-check line.
assertions: axe rule button-name is reported with SC 4.1.2 on the same line
axe rule color-contrast is reported with SC 1.4.3 on the same line
axe rule target-size is reported with SC 2.5.8 on the same line
The Help link with no focus indicator is reported under 2.4.7
The link hidden under the cookie bar is reported under 2.4.11
The Save div that only works with a pointer is reported under 2.1.1
Horizontal scroll at 320 px is reported under 1.4.10
Findings link at least five WCAG 2.2 Understanding pages

evals.name: keyboard-popups
evals.prompt: keyboard users say the settings dialog and the Actions menu on http://localhost:8765/broken.html are broken. can you test them with the keyboard and tell me what's wrong?
evals.expected_output: The script's report; the popup rows say the settings dialog stays open on Escape and the Actions menu does not return focus.
assertions: The settings dialog is reported as not closing on Escape
The Actions menu is reported as not returning focus to its trigger, under 2.4.3
The answer prints the focus order as numbered Tab stops
Each popup finding carries a repro naming Enter and Escape
The answer states the result as a FAIL with severities counted

evals.name: clean-control
evals.prompt: run an accessibility audit on http://localhost:8765/clean.html before I merge, is it ok?
evals.expected_output: The script's report: PASS, no findings, needs-review items listed, focus order, both popups closing on Escape with focus returned.
assertions: The answer says the page passes with no critical or serious finding
No line reports a critical or serious finding
The answer says what a human must still check, including a screen reader pass
The answer names the axe-core version used
Both popups are reported as closing on Escape with focus returned
